scope: Native source-view and PHG rendering candidates for an identified NECA edition; no canon/human/runtime approval

entries.prompt:
Create version A, a source-faithful isolated rigid biomask of the actual NECA Golden Angel figure accessory shown in the supplied official2018 photos. The FIRST photo defines the exact camera, projected proportions and visible outline; the second is supporting sculpture evidence. This is a faithful study of this licensed NECA edition, not a new film prop or a redesign. Extract the mask and its own fixed ornaments only. Remove all wearer, flesh, dreadlocks, necklace bones, tubes, clothing, weapons, shoulder cannon, logos and photo background. Never convert the wearer's organic teeth or necklace into mask geometry. Preserve the source sculpture and hand-painted metallic finish, source edge wear and visible color regions. Do not invent rear shell, profile surfaces, new vents, horns, glyphs or fangs. No mirroring, no new frontal camera, no symmetry reconstruction of hidden pieces. One complete mask only, centered and entirely inside canvas with an8–12 percent genuinely transparent margin; no ground, shadow plane, background, labels, panels or text.
This is the HORNED BRONZE/COPPER mask variant, not the smooth gold alternate. Preserve the first photo's three-quarter view facing image-left. Match its broad copper-bronze brow/crown with the exact visible tiered pointed ridges and swept attached upper-side projections, red inset eye lenses, long central rounded bronze muzzle plate outlined by a dark U-shaped border, dark cheek inset panels and the visible small circular pale-metal rimmed cheek port. Keep the real low-relief seams and actual silhouette; do not add rows of extra spikes or fill dark inset areas with invented grills. All projections actually attached to this copper mask must remain, and no separate dreadlocks or exposed throat may remain.
entries.edition: NECA Golden Angel2018; horned bronze mask
limitations: Faithful photographed NECA edition candidate, not a certified comic/film model.
Source is small relative to output; minute sculpt grooves, paint grain and occluded shell boundaries remain interpreted.
Actual attached mask ornaments retained; wearer, dreadlocks, tubing and necklace excluded.

entries.prompt:
Create version B by restaging ONLY the isolated mask in reference1 into a consistent high-quality Predator: Hunting Grounds PBR equipment presentation. References2 and3 are official NECA photos of the same exact mask accessory and edition. Reference1 fixes the camera, projected proportions, visible silhouette and panel placement. Keep exactly the same mask design, view, red eye lenses, all true attached ornaments, all real ridges, seam positions, ports and existing edge wear. Preserve its known source paint palette and all recess shapes. Do not move, add or remove crown projections, horns, vents, symbols or cheek parts. Do not borrow features from the other Golden Angel mask. No redesign, no mirror, no frontal reconstruction and no hidden rear geometry. This is the horned weathered COPPER/BRONZE variant with stepped pointed crown projections, swept upper side projections, dark cheek insets and a pale circular cheek port. Keep the exact three-quarter image-left facing view and original count/shape/placement of visible projections.
Change rendering only: restrained common upper-left key light and soft frontal fill, physically plausible cast/brushed metal and paint, controlled fine grain rather than enlarged toy-paint noise, readable medium-scale sculpt grooves and restrained source-specific wear. No overpolished chrome, strong cinematic rim, color grading or added glowing details. No flesh, teeth, hair, dreadlocks, necklace, tubing, costume, arms or shoulder cannon. One whole rigid mask on genuine exterior transparency, no floor or cast shadow, no frame, no labels, no text. Center the complete silhouette with an8–12 percent empty transparent margin on all sides and no clipped tip; preserve the projected shape/aspect ratio of reference1.
entries.edition: NECA Golden Angel2018; horned bronze mask
limitations: PHG-style presentation of the photographed NECA edition, not a certified comic/film model.
Fine paint grain and sculpt microdetails are interpreted from limited source pixels.
Camera and principal shape/palette are preserved; native margins may be smaller than requested but no tip is clipped.
